proposed_relation: Two real former exterior patches (roof+front) versus three newly exposed patches, forecasting D=1more by omitting hidden rear loss.
assessment: The former front unit patch has no complete current-material boundary; distinguishing it requires a new ghost upper edge and/or recoloring existing U edges that are also the new side-wall boundaries. This risks overlapping source/receiver roles or a reconstructed closed unit-face frame, and is close to the old roof-versus-three-face family. No clean distinct non-overlapping source presentation was established in this finite offline study.
